---
title: "[VHH]-Hierarchical-Mixed-Clustering-Logo-Plots"
subtitle: "S19 Illumina Run, Family: YAEQGLYGDYLDY (Clone ID: 49)"
output: html_document
date: "2024-03-24"
---

```{r, echo = F, eval = T, warning=F}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(msa))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggseqlogo))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringdist))

# Top groups
top_groups <- function(results, clone_var){
  return(table(results[[clone_var]])[order(table(results[[clone_var]]), decreasing = T)])
}
```

```{r, echo = F, eval = T, warning = F}
# Here we load our results file
df <- read.csv("~/Downloads/S19-Clone-49-results.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

## Entire (Hierarchical) Clonal Family Logo Plot

```{r, echo = F, eval = T, warning = F}
unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(df, "VHH")
unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(df, "junction_aa")

# Pull statistics
median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
#consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)

if (TRUE){
  cat("Group ID: ", paste(unique(substr(df$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(df$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Overall Members: ", nrow(df), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(df$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(df$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(df[df$junction_aa == median_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
  cat("Most-frequent VHH: ", median_VHH, ' (with ',nrow(df[df$VHH == median_VHH,]), ' observations)\n', sep = '')
  print(ggseqlogo(as.character(df$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
    theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", median_CDR3, sep = '')))
}
```


## Top-50 Sub Family (2+ Members) Logo Plots (Sub-family Homology Threshold: 0.95)

### Ordered by VHH Abundance in Clonal Family

```{r, echo = F, eval = T, warning=F}
tab <- top_groups(df, "centroid_id")

for (nm in head(names(tab), 50)){
  tmp_frame <- df[df$centroid_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  # Pull most frequent CDR3
  median_CDR3 <- names(table(tmp_frame$junction_aa)[order(table(tmp_frame$junction_aa), decreasing = T)][1])
  median_VHH <- names(table(tmp_frame$VHH)[order(table(tmp_frame$VHH), decreasing = T)][1])
  
  if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
      cat("Group ID: ", paste('Subfamily',unique(substr(tmp_frame$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id),'-',unique(tmp_frame$centroid_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Overall Members: ", nrow(tmp_frame), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == median_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent VHH: ", median_VHH, ' (with ',nrow(df[df$VHH == median_VHH,]), ' observations)\n', sep = '')
      print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
        theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", median_CDR3, sep = '')))
  }
}
```
